prompt: Define a backlog item for: our CI pipeline is flaky, tests fail intermittently
expected_output: One backlog item classified as spike or chore, scoped to investigating and resolving flaky test failures, with testable acceptance criteria and labeled assumptions.
assertions: Exactly one backlog item is produced
Type is classified (spike or chore, not feature)
Acceptance criteria are observable outcomes, not implementation steps
Scope is limited to one iteration worth of work

prompt: Create a PBI for adding SSO support to the admin portal
expected_output: One backlog item scoped to the smallest deliverable SSO increment (e.g. one provider, one user flow), not a full SSO platform buildout.
assertions: Exactly one backlog item is produced
Scope is explicitly bounded to a single increment
Out-of-scope section lists broader SSO work excluded from this item
Child-task candidates are listed but not fully drafted

prompt: Break this feature into tickets: redesign the checkout flow
expected_output: Should NOT trigger this skill. Should trigger backlog-item-decomposition instead. If triggered, output is limited to one PBI and a candidate list — not fully drafted child tasks.
assertions: Preferred: skill does not trigger; backlog-item-decomposition handles the request
If triggered: output contains only one PBI and candidate task list, not drafted child tasks
